// Gnome Sort

a1 = arr[5, 1, 4, 2, 8]

fun Gnome_Sort(@init<table> array):
    n = length(array)
    pos = 0

    while (pos < n):
        @mark<pos, outline, yellow> if (pos == 0 or array[pos] >= array[pos - 1]):
            pos += 1
        else:
            mark1 = pos - 1
            @mark<pos, highlight, green> @mark<mark1, highlight, green> swap(array[pos], array[pos - 1])
            pos -= 1
        end if
    end while

    return array
end fun

result = Gnome_Sort(a1)

// Binary Search First Greater Or Equal

a1 = arr[1, 3, 5, 5, 6, 9]

fun Binary_Search_First_Greater_Or_Equal(@init<table> array, target):
    left = 0
    right = length(array) - 1
    result = length(array) // Default result if no element found

    while (left <= right):
        mid = floor((left + right) / 2)
        @mark<mid, outline, yellow> if (array[mid] >= target):
            @mark<mid, highlight, green> result = mid // Found a candidate
            right = mid - 1 // Continue searching left half
        else:
            left = mid + 1 // Search right half
        end if
    end while

    return result
end fun

result = Binary_Search_First_Greater_Or_Equal(a1, 5)
